items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Dick Boone left him [Ben Barth], who was running the office

ctx.x: Ben Barth behaved pretty nicely, didn't he?

Ben Barth was a good ... he was just like my father. I mean, even after I left him, he was like my father. I told him I was coming back home when I left him, and he was going on a worldwide tour -- he and Maxine, and Dick Boone left him, who was running the office, and he had cut his world tour to come back here. But I told him before he left, I called him The Traveler, and he called me The Traveler, and I said, "I'm going to Houston", and he'd say, "Oh, you'll be
here when I get out" and I said, "No I won't be, and I'm going. I had enough of this town. I'm going." And I left. I left on June 4, 1959.
